    Configuration¶

    A site turns the theme on with two entries in mkdocs.yml and configures it under extra.fly. The fly plugin validates that block when the build starts: an unknown key, an unknown hue or preset, or a malformed value stops the build with a message that names the key. Every YAML example on this page goes through the same validation in the theme's tests (tests/py/test_demo_site.py).

    Turn the theme on¶

    mkdocs.yml
    theme:
  name: fly-january
plugins:
  - fly

    custom_dir stays available for site-specific templates. A template override named main.html replaces the theme's own and drops its stylesheets and scripts, so prefer a hook or a partial for additions.

    Site keys: extra.fly¶

    Key Default Value
    chrome fontlab fontlab, vexy, none or {script, header, footer}; see chrome
    chrome_options none menu attributes: site-label, site-url (an absolute http(s) URL or a root-relative path; defaults to the site URL), mobile-menu, mobile-search, search-from, and sticky (true pins the bar to the top; default false)
    hue none (accent cobalt) the accent: cherry, tangerine, amber, lime, emerald, teal, sky, cobalt, indigo, violet, magenta, rose or gray
    fonts.sources the theme's five (below) stylesheets loaded on every page: typekit:<kit>, google:<css2 family spec> or an https:// URL; setting it replaces the defaults, [] loads none
    fonts.roles theme defaults per-role overrides, {<role>: {<property>: <value>}}; see tokens
    h1 ink ink or accent: whether every page title takes the hue's text colour; a page whose hue comes from its own front matter or preset always does, unless it sets h1: ink
    links inherit inherit or accent: article links keep the text colour, or take the accent's text colour (contrast-safe in both schemes)
    presets none named {fonts, hue} bundles a page can pick
    margin_side left where margin figures sit: left or right
    utilities false true loads fly-utilities.css, every Tailwind utility with the tw: prefix (1.9 MB)
    debug false true adds a preset switcher (fly-debug.js) for trying looks in the browser

    The default sources are the Typekit kits cmv5add (News Serif, the h1), gav0zux (Quire Sans, h2 and lead), cna4jfp (Sole Serif Small, body) and wck5koo (Grtsk, navigation, tables and the inline sans), and Google's Outfit (buttons): one for each face the default roles name, so a site with no extra.fly is set in them. A site that sets fonts.sources replaces the list, so it names every face its roles use; fonts.sources: [] loads nothing and the roles fall back to their system stacks.

    A complete site block:

    mkdocs.yml
    extra:
  fly:
    chrome: fontlab
    chrome_options:
      site-label: Design system
      site-url: https://design.example/
      mobile-menu: materialx
      mobile-search: materialx
      search-from: docstheme
      sticky: false
    hue: cobalt
    h1: ink
    links: inherit
    fonts:
      sources:
        - typekit:gav0zux
        - google:Outfit:wght@100..900
        - https://example.com/fonts.css
      roles:
        h1: {family: "'newsserif-huge-variable', serif", weight: 700}
        h2: {family: "'quire-sans', sans-serif", weight: 300, scale: 1.1}
        body: {family: "'Outfit', sans-serif", features: '"onum" 1'}
        strong: {weight: 600}
        em: {style: italic}
        sans: {family: "'Outfit', sans-serif", stretch: normal, variation: normal, adjust: 1}
    presets:
      fl9-color:
        fonts:
          sources: [google:Blaka+Ink]
          roles: {h1: {family: "'Blaka Ink'", weight: 400, scale: 1.1}}
        hue: magenta
      plain:
        hue: gray
    margin_side: right
    utilities: false
    debug: false

    typekit:gav0zux loads https://use.typekit.net/gav0zux.css; google:Outfit:wght@100..900 loads https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@100..900&display=swap. Join several Google families into one stylesheet with &family=:

    mkdocs.yml
    extra:
  fly:
    fonts:
      sources:
        - google:Outfit:wght@100..900&family=REM:wght@100..900

    Role properties: block roles (h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, body, lead, nav, table, caption, code) take family, weight, stretch, features, variation, size, leading, tracking and scale; h1 and h2 also take measure (a length in ch, rem, em, px or %, or none); inline roles: em takes family, weight, adjust and style (normal or italic); strong and mono take family, weight and adjust; sans (the face of links, marks and h6) takes family, stretch, variation and adjust. Values are plain CSS: a value that could end its declaration (;, braces, <, a comment or an unbalanced quote) is rejected.

    These blocks fail the build:

    Invalid: unknown hue
    extra:
  fly:
    hue: crimson
    Invalid: unknown key
    extra:
  fly:
    colour: cobalt
    Invalid: font source without a scheme
    extra:
  fly:
    fonts:
      sources: [fonts.example.com/a.css]
    Invalid: role value that ends the declaration
    extra:
  fly:
    fonts:
      roles:
        h1: {family: "serif; color: red"}

    Page keys: front matter¶

    A page can change its look. Precedence: page fonts and hue over the page's preset over the site. Font sources accumulate (each loaded once); roles merge property by property. These examples assume the site block above.

    Page front matter
    fly:
  preset: fl9-color
    Page front matter
    fly:
  preset: plain
  hue: teal
  h1: ink
  fonts:
    sources: [typekit:abc1def]
    roles:
      h1: {weight: 300}
      body: {features: '"onum" 1'}

    The legacy key subtheme is read as fly.preset and also adds subtheme-<name> to <body>:

    Page front matter
    subtheme: fl9-color

    Other page keys the plugin reads:

    Page front matter
    classes:
  body: [wide-page]
  main: ref-main
  article: [specimen]
margin_side: left
hide: [toc]

    classes adds classes to the first <body>, <main> and <article>; margin_side overrides extra.fly.margin_side (fly-margin-left or fly-margin-right on <body>); hide: [toc] removes the page's table of contents (fly-no-l2).

    These page blocks fail the build:

    Invalid page: unknown preset
    fly:
  preset: newspaper
    Invalid page: subtheme and preset disagree
    subtheme: plain
fly:
  preset: fl9-color
